Definition: perhaps the same as ταρσός (a flat basket); Tarsus, a place in Asia Minor:--Tarsus.
BiblicalUsage: Tarsus was a city of Cilicia in Asia Minor, where Paul was born. The brethren brought Paul down to Caesarea and sent him forth to Tarsus; Barnabas went to Tarsus to seek Saul and brought him to Antioch; and Paul says, I am verily a man which am a Jew, born in Tarsus, a city in Cilicia.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the city that gave Paul his citizenship also gave him his learning, and God used both.
